subject_property.description: Property identification for the appraised ranch or farm, from the report summary page.

state.description: State of the subject property, as printed (e.g. MT).

zip_code.description: ZIP code of the subject property.

total_deeded_acres.description: Total deeded acres of the subject property.

effective_unit_size.description: Effective unit size used in the valuation, in acres.

highest_and_best_use_as_vacant.description: Highest and best use 'As If' Vacant.

rights_appraised.description: Property rights appraised, e.g. Fee Simple.

report_type.description: Report type, e.g. Appraisal Report (Standards Rule 2-2).

effective_date_of_appraisal.description: Effective date of the appraisal as YYYY-MM-DD.

value_indications.description: The value indicated by each of the three approaches, in USD.

cost_approach.description: Value indicated by the Cost Approach, in USD.

income_approach.description: Value indicated by the Income Approach, in USD.

sales_comparison_approach.description: Value indicated by the Sales Comparison Approach, in USD.

opinion_of_value.description: Final opinion of market value, in USD.

allocation.description: Allocation of the overall value between land and improvements.

land_value.description: Value allocated to land, in USD.

land_value_per_acre.description: Land value per acre, in USD.

land_percent.description: Land share of the overall value, in percent.

structural_improvement_percent.description: Structural improvement share of the overall value, in percent.

overall_value_per_acre.description: Overall value per acre, in USD.

gross_income_estimate.description: Total gross income estimate (cash rent), in USD per year.

total_expenses.description: Total expenses, in USD per year.

net_property_income.description: Net property income, in USD per year.

overall_cap_rate_percent.description: Overall capitalization rate used, in percent.

comparable_sales.description: Every comparable sale in the Sales Comparison Approach grids, in the order they appear (Sale #1 to Sale #10).

sale_number.description: Sale number in the grid, e.g. 1 for Sale #1.

database_id.description: Sale database identifier printed beside the sale number, e.g. D155.

acres.description: Effective unit size of the sale, in acres.

cev_price_per_acre.description: Cash equivalent price per acre, in USD.

time_adjusted_price_per_acre.description: Time-adjusted price per acre, in USD.

net_adjustments.description: Net adjustments per acre, in USD.

adjusted_price_per_acre.description: Final adjusted price per acre, in USD.

value_range_low_per_acre.description: Low end of the property basis value range, in USD per acre.

value_range_high_per_acre.description: High end of the property basis value range, in USD per acre.

concluded_price_per_acre.description: Concluded unit basis price per acre, in USD.
